title: How does a write reach the disk?
question: A write is in memory until it is written back. fsync() makes it durable now: what does that take?

stops.note: Now the data must reach the disk.
Write the dirty page back: now a block is chosen for it, by the multiblock allocator, from the block bitmap.
The journal (jbd2, its own thread) commits the metadata changes: the bitmaps, the inode, the directory block.
The block layer: an I/O request to the disk, /dev/loop0, whose blocks are a file in memory.
